# Harikrishnan G - Portfolio & Professional Information
> Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer based in Kerala, India.

## Summary
Harikrishnan G is a Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer specializing in building high-performance web applications using React.js, Next.js, and the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js), along with enterprise SaaS platforms, drone technology systems, and AI automation workflows. He holds an MSc and BSc in Mathematics and applies strong algorithmic, analytical, and software architecture principles to modern full-stack development.
